{{Quote|Whyren's Reserve, Batch Number NN182. The rarest of the rare. I could sell the ''Falcon'' and maybe&mdash;''maybe''&mdash;buy a case of this stuff.|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 3">[[Star Wars (2013) 3|''Star Wars'' (2013) 3]]</ref>}}
[[File:Whyrens_Reserve_Batch_NN182.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Han Solo holding a bottle of Batch Number NN182]]

'''NN182''' was a batch of the rarest type of the extremely rare and expensive [[Corellian whiskey/Legends|Corellian whiskey]], [[Whyren's Reserve/Legends|Whyren's Reserve]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] estimated that a case of this batch was equivalent to, if not more valuable than, the cost of his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
